summary: The customer called to complain about a rude representative who hung up on them earlier, and also to dispute a $40 data overage charge. The agent apologized, logged a formal complaint against the previous employee, reassured the customer, and then proceeded to investigate and help resolve the billing dispute.

evidence.text: It will be reviewed by the customer relations manager today.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Have the formal complaint reviewed by the customer relations manager today.

evidence.text: Let's see what we can do about waiving that charge for you today.
evidence.speaker: Agent

commitments.description: Investigate and potentially waive the $40 data overage charge.

evidence.text: I sincerely apologize for that behavior. That is definitely not the standard of service we expect our team to provide.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent maintained a calm, polite, and professional demeanor throughout the call, successfully de-escalating an angry customer.

evidence.text: I am so sorry, that is completely unacceptable customer service, and I completely understand why you are upset.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent repeatedly validated the customer's feelings and showed genuine understanding and empathy regarding the poor treatment.

evidence.text: Let me pull up your usage logs for last month.
evidence.speaker: Agent

rubric_scores.justification: The agent successfully de-escalated the complaint issue and immediately moved to address the billing dispute efficiently.

evidence.text: I completely understand your frustration, and I can certainly get a supervisor on the line for you if you'd like. However, before I do that, I would love the opportunity to look at your bill myself and resolve the actual issue you called about.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent communicated clearly, structured options well, and explained the next steps without confusion.

rubric_scores.justification: The agent accurately understood the customer's requests and correctly informed them of the complaint logging process.
